post.description: Session requests a durable immutable snapshot of current active Rules for one session/shift. Same eventId/sessionId/shiftId replays original snapshot; changed event content or rebinding a shift returns 409. No callbacks or retries. Backend-hop contract only. Caller sends its distinct caller credential to Gateway; Gateway must authenticate/allowlist it, replace it with the receiver token and stamp X-Service-Name. These routes are not registered in the released Gateway.
